text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus didn't show up for training, 
so while searching for her—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Sorry, Trainer! Um... the truth is, 
I--

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Pegasus Daaash! Head straight to 
training like this—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Carrotman is on!? They started airing 
the reruns again!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Walk on~♪ Carrot~♪ Carrying loneliness~♪ 
on your back~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! To become a hero like that, I'm 
gonna work hard at my specia...――Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Since she seemed deeply remorseful, I 
told her to be more careful in the future.
